chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī, from the one who mentioned it, from Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), who said:

When my father, ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn (عليه السلام), passed away, a she-camel of his came from the pasture until she struck her neck upon the grave and rolled upon it. So I ordered concerning her, and she was returned to her pasture. My father (عليه السلام) used to perform hajj upon her and perform ʿumrah, and he had never struck her even a single strike at all.

key_terms.الرَّعْيِ: pasture or grazing place from which the animal came
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave of Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn (عليه السلام)
key_terms.نَاقَةٌ: a she-camel belonging to the Imam

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the she-camel of Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn (عليه السلام) after his death?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates an incident after the death of Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn (عليه السلام), when his she-camel came to his grave and displayed a striking reaction. It also highlights his gentle conduct toward the animal, noting that he used her for hajj and ʿumrah yet never struck her.
